## Efficacité d'un traitement

:::::: columns
:::: {.column width="50%"}
$n=10$ patients traités, $k=7$ guéris

Comment estimer $\theta$, probabilité de guérison ?

::: fragment
[**Estimateur du maximum de vraisemblance (EMV)**]{style="color:#F5B12E"} :

-   Vraisemblance, loi binomiale : $P(D=k) = {n\choose k} \theta^k (1-\theta)^{n-k}$
    -   [${n\choose k} = \frac{n!}{k!(n-k)!}$]{style="color:#ADD2D8"}
-   EMV=$k/n$ = 0,70
:::
::::

::: {.column width="50%"}
```{r}
#| label: vraisemblance
#| fig-height: 6
#| fig-width: 6
#| fig-align: center
#| out-width: "90%"

ggplot() + geom_function(colour = RoSq, size = 2,
                         fun = \(x) choose(10, 7)*x^7*(1-x)^(10-7),
                         xlim = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(y=expression(paste("P(D|",theta,")")), x = expression(theta)) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 0.3)) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 1 ,by = 0.2)) +
  geom_segment(aes(x=0.7, y=0, xend=0.7, yend=choose(10,7)*0.7^7*(1-0.7)^3),
               linetype=2, linewidth=2, color=BlFoSq) +
  annotate("text", x = 0.7, y = choose(10,7)*0.7^7*(1-0.7)^3, parse=TRUE,
           label = "theta == 0.7", color=BlFoSq, size=8, vjust="bottom") +
  theme_grey(base_size=25)
```
